extracted.name: Nacho Cheese Sauce with Jalapeno
extracted.description: Pickled jalapenos and pickled jalapeno juice are combined with American cheese to make an ooey-gooey nacho cheese sauce with a kick.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 (1 pound) loaf processed cheese food (such as Velveeta®)
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium-low heat. Add onion, garlic, and jalapeno; cook and stir until onion turns translucent, about 5 minutes.

Stir flour into onion mixture until vegetables are evenly coated. Pour in milk; cook and stir until mixture thickens slightly, 3 to 4 minutes. Add processed cheese food, stirring constantly, until melted and smooth, about 15 minutes more. Stir in pickled jalapeno juice.
